compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem
Six workflow files contain repeated, obvious, historical, or stale prose. Scope was revalidated on `origin/main@d6669496cae4`, including the new named Windows-lock proof in `test.yml`. Shortening comments must preserve trigger, permission, security, portability, and evidence contracts.

## Approach
Edit only allowlisted standalone comments and adjacent blank lines. Preserve workflow data, embedded shell, expressions, and behavior-bearing directives byte-for-byte. Replace narration with the minimum current rationale needed by each consumer.

## Scope
- `reconcile-bridge.yml` — Preserve copyable-client semantics; hourly/manual modes; Actions and ref-lock concurrency; full-history tickets worktree with merge-not-rebase/merge driver; job-local permissions; completed-pass-only 60-minute ceiling; pinned acli; temporary signing key/unsigned fallback; fail-loud no-op detection; default-off paced continuous chain with bounded failure handling; and conditional dimensionless CloudWatch metrics that never alter job outcome.
- `release.yml` — Preserve dispatch-from-main authorization; version/registry/ancestry/environment/advisory guards; immutable pins; build-once artifacts with digest and baked-commit provenance; installed archive tests; exact-byte OIDC PyPI promotion; post-publish tag/release; publisher-digest verification before OIDC; bounded idempotent registry publish; evidence fragments; both `shellcheck disable=SC1091` directives; and the `zizmor` marker.
- `structured-output-baseline.yml` — Preserve manual canonical-repository billable measurement; pre-call budget refusal; independent provider arms and secrets; Bedrock OIDC with both regions and step-confined exchange; external-test opt-in; provider overlays; 3600-second sweep bound; and always-uploaded unique raw results.
- `terraform-drift.yml` — Preserve Terraform-path PR plus daily/manual triggers; independent fmt/plan jobs; plan-only OIDC; full-history checkout and current-tree assertion; Terraform 1.11.4 floor; validate-before-plan; detailed exit codes with `-lock=false`; advisory role outside Gerrit Verified; and the exact `mechanism-ok: ci_gate` marker.
- `test.yml` — Preserve ordinary pushes excluding `feature/**`, `main`, and `tickets`; all PRs; six-hour/manual health; same-ref cancellation; shared Gerrit workflows; schedule-only mutation omission; clean-install path; soft last-green/bisect report; external self-skip behavior; breadth-tier distinctions; nonblocking link check; and the exact existing `predates-gate-ok` marker. For the named Windows exclusive-leg proof, condense the explanatory blocks before the `mechanism-ok` marker and between the step name and `continue-on-error`; preserve the complete `mechanism-ok: ci_gate` marker, if-present guard, bash shell, nonblocking disposition, placement before the default suite, and verbose platform-test command. Do not claim every trigger runs the full suite.
- `verify-identity.yml` — Preserve config-driven advisory authentication and grandfathering; triggers/exclusions; full-history blobless checkout; temporary fail-closed pack limit with restoration; tickets worktree; ancestry-based key verification; object-database immutability; and config-driven op-cert verification without CI overrides.

Consumers are GitHub Actions, Gerrit Verified, release and Terraform operators, PyPI/MCP Registry/GitHub Releases, Jira/tickets reconciliation, CloudWatch, and repository workflow-policy tests.

- [x] Only allowlisted standalone comments or adjacent blank lines change in the six paths; workflow data, embedded shell, and directives remain exact.
- [x] [non-codebase] Every Scope constraint and consumer has a concrete before/final PASS citation in a leaf-linked TSV authored by a reviewer who did not write the remediation.

- [x] [non-codebase] Every edited block is shorter and records `semantic-preservation=PASS` and `bloat-removal=PASS`; missing or failing rows block closure.
  provenance: environment=isolated-local-review-worktree; principal=/root:couped-parttime-nag-independent-review; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=static-analysis — Counted every reviewed block and recorded strict shrink plus both PASS dispositions in all 56 linked TSV rows.
- [x] The comment-only guard, directive census, focused workflow tests, path-scoped `git diff --check`, and worktree-venv repository gate pass.

## Verification

verify_commands.command:
rtk proxy env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" .venv/bin/python -c 'import re,subprocess,sys
pat=re.compile(r"#\s*(?:shellcheck\b|zizmor:|predates-gate-ok:|mechanism-ok:)",re.I)
def rows(ref,path):
 lines=subprocess.check_output(["git","show",f"{ref}:{path}"],text=True).splitlines()
 out=[]
 for i,line in enumerate(lines):
  if pat.search(line):
   nxt=next((x for x in lines[i+1:] if x.strip() and not x.lstrip().startswith("#")),"<EOF>")
   out.append((line,nxt))
 return out
bad=[p for p in sys.argv[1:] if rows("HEAD^",p)!=rows("HEAD",p)]
assert not bad,f"workflow directive text or attachment changed: {bad}"' .github/workflows/reconcile-bridge.yml .github/workflows/release.yml .github/workflows/structured-output-baseline.yml .github/workflows/terraform-drift.yml .github/workflows/test.yml .github/workflows/verify-identity.yml
